SubLayerProcessing.SQLScript: SELECT h.hcc_code, h.hcc_description, h.hcc_model_version, h.hcc_model_type, h.is_chronic_condition, h.effective_year, h.effective_start_date, h.effective_end_date, h.hash_key, hash(concat(IfNull(h.hcc_code, '|'), '|', IfNull(h.hcc_model_version, '|'), '|', IfNull(h.hcc_model_type, '|'), '|', IfNull(h.effective_year, '|'))) AS hcc_key FROM hcc h
SubLayerProcessing.MergeScript: MERGE INTO claimsprocessing.gold.gold_dimhcc t USING (SELECT * FROM tempSQLScript) s ON IfNull(s.hcc_code,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_code,'|') AND IfNull(s.effective_year,'|') = IfNull(t.effective_year,'|') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_version,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_version,'|') AND IfNull(s.hcc_model_type,'|') = IfNull(t.hcc_model_type,'|') WHEN MATCHED AND t.hash_key <> s.hash_key THEN UPDATE SET hcc_code = s.hcc_code, hcc_description = s.hcc_description, hcc_model_version = s.hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type = s.hcc_model_type, is_chronic_condition = s.is_chronic_condition, effective_year = s.effective_year, effective_start_date = s.effective_start_date, effective_end_date = s.effective_end_date, hash_key = s.hash_key, hcc_key = s.hcc_key WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (hcc_code, hcc_description, hcc_model_version, hcc_model_type, is_chronic_condition, effective_year, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, hash_key, hcc_key) VALUES (s.hcc_code, s.hcc_description, s.hcc_model_version, s.hcc_model_type, s.is_chronic_condition, s.effective_year, s.effective_start_date, s.effective_end_date, s.hash_key, s.hcc_key)
